## Company: Ayala Corporation (AC)
Sector: Holding Firms / Holding Firms
Ayala Corporation (AC) was founded in 1834, incorporated on January 23, 1968, and was listed on the Philippine Stock Exchange in 1976.

AC is the holding company of the Ayala Group of Companies, with principal business interests in real estate and hotels, financial services, telecommunications, power, healthcare, logistics, industrial technologies and automotives, infrastructure, education, technology services, business process outsourcing, air charter, consulting services, and investment holdings.

The significant subsidiaries of AC as of December 31, 2025, are Ayala Land, Inc., Bank of the Philippine Islands, AC Energy and Infrastructure Corporation, and Globe Telecom, Inc.

Source: SEC Form 17-A (2025)
